brief.genre: daft orchestral adventure, light and cheeky
brief.use: main background song for Gauntlet Grind (background loop, quiet under play)
brief.game: Gauntlet Grind: physics-driven gauntlet runner; blades, darts, crushers and worse over a pit; six zones each with its own tune; the tone is slapstick and gleeful
brief.references: a tongue-in-cheek fanfare: pizzicato bounce, a violin tune, a flute answer in the middle eight, a brass wink at the end
brief.notes: 32-bar loop (A A2 B B2) at 120 bpm. Voice-led chords, real patches. Target -18 LUFS for background. Zone tunes are synthesised in src/music.ts; this is the title/background song.
